texts:
Your AI has a brain. Give it a body. In the Forge, text or photos become a textured 3D model you can orbit, view in AR and download.

Pick the engine that builds it, and several are free to use. Below the prompt, a live feed shows what other people just forged, each one ready to open in the viewer or remix.

Quality has three tiers: Draft, Standard and High. High is a $THREE holder feature: hold to unlock, or pay per generation.

Open the Forge and try a prompt: three.ws/forge

issues.quote: Your AI has a brain. Give it a body.
issues.problem: The two-short-sentence drumbeat sits close to the banned 'one-word-sentence drumbeat' pattern and edges into copywriting rather than stating what the Forge does first; the mechanism lead ('text or photos become a textured 3D model...') is the stronger true statement and could open the post.
issues.fix: Optional: open directly on 'In the Forge, text or photos become a textured 3D model you can orbit, view in AR and download.' and drop the brain/body framing.
